user.title: Connect OTTPlay Control Server
user.description: Use a scoped operator token with comma-separated player IDs. Administrator tokens can discover all registered players when IDs are blank. The token controls the selected players; use HTTPS or a trusted local network. Credentials remain in Home Assistant.

error.invalid_auth: The token is invalid or lacks device/action permissions. A scoped token requires explicit player IDs; leave IDs blank only for an administrator token.

error.invalid_input: Enter an HTTP(S) server URL, a valid token and comma-separated unique player IDs.
